snippet.title: 33 Immortals - Update 3 (ESRB)
snippet.description:
A brand new update has just been released for 33 Immortals! Ready to face The Wrath of God? Jump in now on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC, and with Xbox Game Pass and the Epic Games Store.  

Update 3 is now live and includes:

 - Unique Elite enemies that are larger and stronger
 - Legendary weapon skins that drop when you defeat major bosses like Lucifer or Adam & Eve
 - Daily events
 - And much more!

The rebellion continues, and so do the improvements!
